# Maintaining Our Divine Connection While Living in the Material World

### Swami Chidananda Giri • Yogoda Satsanga Society of India

Welcome and greetings. Swami Chidananda Giri guides us on how to maintain our divine connection while fulfilling our duties in this materialistic world. Our Master taught that true spirituality does not mean running away to a forest; it is the art of self-mastery wherever you are.

### The Portable Temple of Silence

By practicing daily scientific meditation, we build a castle of silence within our souls. When we are anchored in this inner calm, the storms of worldly responsibilities cannot shake our balance. We can work with high efficiency while our mind rest in His peace.

> "Keep your hands active in the service of your family, but keep your mind anchored at the feet of the Divine. This is the highest yoga of action."

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Morning Meditation:** Begin each morning with a deep period of silence and prayer before turning on any devices.
* **Spiritual Rest:** Take small 2-minute 'stillness breaks' during your busy workday to refocus at the spiritual eye.
* **No Ego:** Perform all duties with the attitude that you are merely an instrument of His cosmic will.
* **Night Sadhana:** End each day with a calm meditation to wash away the dust of worldly worries.

In His light you are secure. Jai Guru!
